pages.text: Works as a room or as open ground. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Updraft, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 8.
Will not count without:$(li)4 of Soul Sand$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Soul Sand$(li)any banners$(li)Water$(li)Glass or Glass Pane$(li)Scaffolding$(p)Counts against it:$(li)Magma Block$(li)any crops
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)The room stands taller than it is wide, at least 1.50x, best at 3x, and perch crowns the structure, within 1 of its highest layer, and tube encloses the room, and banner is beside perch.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Perch: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(li)Tube: Glass or Glass Pane$(li)Banner: any banners
pages.title: How you arrange it
